title: Questions 139-142 refer to the following memo.
passage_1:
To: All Staff
From: Corinne Baptiste

Subject: The Following Week

Please postpone appointments that are not ------- (141). However, vital ones can be run over a conference call. If any difficulties ------- (142) while working off-site, please alert me straight away. You can contact me through the internal chat tool or on 555-0713.

Corinne Baptiste
Operations Director, Kestrel Media
